Colonia3D at prometheus conference 2011

Matthias Trapp, member of the HPI Computer Graphics Systems research group, is giving a talk on “Colonia3D – Potentials of the Interactive Communication of Digital Heritage in Public Spaces” at the prometheus conference  201, which is held on November 4-5 2011 at the University of Cologne.

Conference website: prometheus-bildarchiv.de/about/tagung2011/index
